finding.title: Page-29 Celt C hit-marker detail truncates the visible 4 digit
finding.description: Fresh original inspection shows the intended visible 4 hit-marker crop cuts through the right stem. In the independently selected original-source window [130,513,138,523] points, 51 red/yellow visible stem pixels lie outside the intended component; missing 144-DPI pixel bounds are [266,1026,272,1040]. The same region revision and incomplete intended crop appear in final-verified and both complete replays.
finding.consequence: The authored component and exact evidence are incomplete. Whole-page primary tiles retain the marker, and preservation/denominators pass; those do not satisfy the intended detail-component completeness criterion.
affected_criteria: Account for every page region: clauses, headings, notes, examples, diagrams, tables/legends and editorial exclusions.

Author disjoint regions independently of KB headings, including headings, clauses, notes, examples, tables/cells/legends, diagrams/components and editorial material. Do not use broad mixed regions to hide components; record uncertainty and any uncovered geometric area explicitly. Gaps and placeholders never count as represented source content.

Fresh source-region evidence includes exact crop PDF, PNG, text, page_basis_hash, region revision, offsets, engines, DPI, dimensions, safe paths and SHA-256. The root source-pins.json exhaustively indexes every assigned original-page and new region/component artifact and both replays; each referenced artifact exists at its pinned path and is included in the frozen delivery.

Run two COMPLETE independent replays separately from the pinned baseline and same persisted registry/author selections into fresh replay-1 and replay-2 directories. Generate evidence serially for the entire region/component set in each. Compare stable IDs, author fields, reading order, links, registry and path-normalized artifact bytes/locators; report actual path-dependent inventory hashes without claiming they must be identical.
finding.required_repair: In a new coordinator-authorized repair attempt, correct or split the zero-denominator C hit-marker selection so the full visible 4 and marker are included in intended component evidence. Preserve all disjoint primary tiles, accepted baseline objects, registry history and frozen attempts. Regenerate affected evidence and dependent reports/indexes plus complete final/replay artifact sets at fresh paths.
repair_validation: Freshly compare the complete visible digit and marker against original physical page 29. Add a source-bound regression that rejects [106,496,133,527] and checks the full visible stem/marker extent; a key-set or single-pixel check is insufficient. Verify the 51-pixel witness patch is included in the intended detail, not merely a primary tile or adjacent counter.
Recheck every assigned component and context boundary; preserve the resolved F01 full-arrow masks and page-33 exact clipping. Keep context denominator zero.

Generate the complete final and two independent serial replay sets separately, and verify stable identities, registry history, normalized bytes/locators, complete current indexes, baseline preservation and all delivery hashes.

Rerun unchanged source suite, the three pinned source CLI validators via task_access, owned batch verifier, scripts/check.ps1 -Task IG-2B08 and git diff --check. Use approved exact-command execution for observed Windows access failures. Obtain fresh independent review.

resolved_findings_to_preserve.basis: Fresh full-arrow visual comparison and all 199/194 cyan-mask plus 458 black-arrow source pixels verified inside intended final/replay evidence; old truncated crop rejected.
